ideas.title: The Impact of Trump's Funding Freeze on Minnesota's Social Services
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Trump administration's funding freeze on Minnesota's social services, including child care and aid to the poor.
questions: What are the specific effects of the funding freeze on Minnesota's social services?
How many people will be affected by the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: This story could have significant implications for the people of Minnesota and could shed light on the administration's priorities.
